items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Of course then he goes on to play with Sonny but that’s later.

ctx.x: Yeah. Jim lasted, you know, to the point -- Jim might have just got bored. I don’t know.
Of course then he goes on to play with Sonny but that’s later.
That was way down the line. He started with -- well he got to do some deals with Jimmy Guiffre and he dug that so -- plus the fact he wanted to stay east, you know.
